title: Baa Juice Strawberry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Strawberry Ice Nic Salt pairs the ripe, juicy sweetness of Strawberry with a brisk layer of Ice for a cool twist on a classic fruit flavour. The Strawberry comes through with a burst of summer brightness, while the clean icy finish keeps each puff feeling crisp and refreshing. Part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is formulated with double-concentrated flavour to capture the impactful taste associated with bar-style vapes. The 50VG/50PG ratio makes it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring bright flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a smooth throat hit. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Baa Juice Strawberry Ice Nic Salt is a fruity all-day vape that works best with refillable pod kits and vape starter kits .
